title: Duba kuɗin ku na yau da kullun a sarari: shiri, caji da aminci

say: Duba kuɗin ku na yau da kullun a sarari: shiri, caji da aminci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module ɗaya na Sarrafa Kuɗi a Rayuwar yau da kullun.
Mata biyu suna iya samun kusan iri ɗaya kuma suna rayuwa daban. Sau da yawa bambancin ba kudin shiga ba ne. Shi ne yadda ake yanke shawarar kuɗi na yau da kullun.
Kowane gida yana da sassa uku. Kudi a ciki shine duk abin da kuke karɓa: albashi, tallace-tallace, biyan kuɗi don sabis, ko kuɗi daga dangi.

say: Ga misalin aiki. Ana biyan Ngozi kimanin naira 120,000 a karshen wata. Ba ta da wani shiri kuma tana kashewa kamar yadda buƙatu suka bayyana.

card.title: Gano kwanakin rata a cikin watan albashi

say: A sati na daya tana kashe naira 48,000. A mako na 2 ta kashe 36,000, gami da takalma na 12,000 waɗanda ba a shirya su ba. A mako na 3 tana kashe 28,000.

card.title: Gano kwanakin rata a cikin watan albashi
rows: Makon 2, tare da takalma maras shiri

say: Naira 112,000 ne suka tafi a cikin makonni uku, wanda ya rage kawai 8,000. Sati na 4 har yanzu yana buƙatar sufuri da abinci, don haka ta kusan 10,000 gajere kuma ta yi rance.
Matsalar ba karancin albashi ba ce. An yi lodin gaba. Da shirin ta na sakin naira 30,000 duk mako, kuma a satin tata hudu ya bace.

say: Tsaron waya shine aminci na kuɗi. Barayi ba kasafai suke shiga bankuna ba. Suna yaudarar mai shi, ko kuma su ɗauki waya mara kullewa.
Saita makullin allo wanda ba shekarar haihuwar ku ba, kuma kunna makullin cikin kowane banki da aikace-aikacen walat.

say: Rubuta lambar kula da abokin ciniki ta bankin ku a cikin littafin rubutu a gida, don haka zaku iya toshe asusunku cikin sauri idan an sace wayarku.

Babu wani banki na gaske, wakili ko ofishi da zai nemi PIN, kalmar sirri ko OTP. Idan kowa ya tambaya, ƙare kiran. Kuma kar a taɓa amincewa da faɗakarwar SMS shi kaɗai. Duba ma'aunin ku a cikin app ɗin ku.
